title: The Hidden Reasons Behind Weak Water Pressure
description: Turning on the shower or tap only to get a weak trickle is a common frustration for homeowners. Low water pressure usually comes down to a few key culprits. Mineral scale buildup inside pipes or faucet aerators gradually restricts flow over time. A partially closed main water shut-off valve, a malfunctioning pressure reducing valve, or hidden supply line leaks can also cause a sudden pressure drop. If the issue is isolated to a single fixture, clearing mineral debris from the aerator often solves it. However, if low pressure affects your whole home, it is best to have a professional plumber inspect your main line and pressure valves.
